description: Search project memory. Returns a compact index (~50-100 tokens/result). Do not use as a follow-up to a complete memorix_project_context brief unless a specific fact is still missing or the user asks for deeper history; provide purpose when intentionally expanding. Use memorix_detail to fetch full content for specific IDs. Use memorix_timeline to see chronological context. Searches across all observations stored from any IDE session — enabling cross-session and cross-agent context retrieval.

force.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to read a record already represented in the latest Autopilot brief.

maxTokens.description: Token budget — trim results to fit (0 = unlimited)

purpose.description: Why this must expand beyond the latest Autopilot brief. Name the missing fact or the user's explicit request.

quality.description: Retrieval profile: fast stays local, balanced uses configured embeddings, thorough explicitly permits optional LLM refinement.

scope.description: Search scope: "project" (default) only searches current project, "global" searches all projects

since.description: Only return observations created after this date (ISO 8601 or natural like "2025-01-15")

source.description: Filter by memory source. "git" returns only commit-derived ground truth memories. Omit for all sources.

status.description: Filter by memory status. "active" (default) shows current memories, "all" includes resolved/archived.

until.description: Only return observations created before this date (ISO 8601 or natural like "2025-02-01")

name: memorix_search
title: Search Memory
